mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (as a continuous variable) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate environments are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals improving labor market conditions, which leads to positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances despite UNRATE < 5.0% condition, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL > 220.0) indicates a stable economic environment with moderate inflation, supporting positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS rising above 1.0% over a 3-month period), increased discount rates and reduced liquidity lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or the tightening cycle condition does not yield statistically significant negative returns (p > 0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (as a continuous variable) indicates a weak labor market, leading to negative equity returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in high-unemployment environments are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand for residential construction, leading to positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in < 40% of instances where HOUST is above 550.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 (index 2017=100) signals a weakening supply chain and potential recession, leading to negative equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST > 550.0) and rising residential sales (RSAFS > 380000.0) indicates strong demand for housing and consumer goods, supporting positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.
